name: Visualization Charts
project_description:
The Visualization Charts module allows you to create interactive visualization using CSV data sources. This modules provides the ability to create NVD3 charts. It enables content creators to provide more meaning to raw data, illustrate trends and engage users. 

 It can handle a CSV file with one of the delimiters listed below.

 
 Comma (,) 
 Semicolon (;) 
 Pipe (|) 
 Space ( ) 
 
 Usage 
 Once the module is enabled, new chart entities can be created by going to /visualization-charts/add. A multi-step process will guide you through creation of a chart based on an uploaded data file.

 Visit the documentation guide for information on how to install and use the module. 

 You can also check out our Examples guide to see what the final product might look like.

 Support
